patterns.prefix: Environment variable not found for key:

trigger.condition: Selected explicit process/user/machine scope or default process→user→machine fallback returns null; explicit empty string is not this guard.

likelyCauses.text: Selected explicit process/user/machine scope or default process→user→machine fallback returns null; explicit empty string is not this guard.

diagnostics.action: Inspect selected scope and null-versus-empty flags; never retain variable name/value.
diagnostics.expected: Redacted flags identify this source guard without token value, graph, environment or provider effect.

correction.boundary: Diagnostic source-owner handoff only; no token, Signal, graph, environment, SDA, storage or provider state change/retry.

steps.action: Record environment owner handoff or propose intended scope/key correction after confirming ownership; do not write process/user/machine variables.
steps.expected: Owner handoff recorded; guard clearance not claimed.

stopWhen: Canonical mapped/concrete identity, Get activity or exact message/pattern differs.
Effective path, registration, selected scope or owner cannot be established with redacted metadata.
Proposed action would reveal token value/name, graph, credentials, SDA content or execute provider/storage/enrollment effects.

entries.redaction: Exclude token path/key/value, Plan/Config/Signal/graph/Jacket/Conductor, environment name/value, storage or SDA identity/content, credentials and exception text; retain canonical adapter/activity, exact message/pattern and nonsecret guard flags only.
limitations: A passed local guard, warning or Result presence does not establish token value, absence or safe retry.

emittedMessages.text: Cannot construct Token_Environment — provided dictionary is null.

trigger.condition: Token_Environment.Construct receives null dictionary before Jacket/Signal assignment.

likelyCauses.text: Token_Environment.Construct receives null dictionary before Jacket/Signal assignment.

diagnostics.action: Inspect Token_Environment concrete identity and construction dictionary-null flag; redact dictionary.
diagnostics.expected: Redacted flags identify this source guard without token value, graph, environment or provider effect.

correction.boundary: Conditional originating Plan or construction input proposal only; no token/provider effect here.

steps.action: Supply intended nonnull construction dictionary through owning registration/Jacket plan.
steps.expected: Dictionary nonnull; concrete Get and provider effects separate.
